text:
Tessa (People Ops): Quick ask — I'm building a '30s goal + feedback microbank' for the upcoming performance cycle. Need very short, copy-pasteable lines for: goal one-liners, 1-sentence self-review starters, manager praise snippets, and a couple calibration cues. Can you drop examples here by Thu EOD? :sparkles:

Miguel: Posted a few to start. Keeping them <30s each.

Miguel: ```GOAL ONE-LINERS
- Increase embeddings pipeline throughput by 20% to cut inference cost per request.
- Ship unified logging for model A/B experiments to reduce manual analysis time by 3x.
- Reduce median tail latency for /generate to <150ms under p95 load.```

Priya: Nice. Here are self-review starters (one sentence each):

Priya: ```SELF-REVIEW STARTERS
- Focused on shipping reliable batching which improved cost efficiency and reduced ops toil.
- Led cross-team design for rollout policy enabling safer canaries and faster rollbacks.
- Drove adoption of automated evals to catch quality regressions before deploy.```

Samir: Manager praise snippets (drop into Slack or review comments):

Samir: ```MANAGER PRAISE SNIPPETS
- Delivered high-impact infra changes with attention to reliability and docs.
- Proactively removed blockers for the team; excellent stakeholder communication.
- Demonstrated thoughtful tradeoffs between cost and latency—kept product needs central.```

Anjali: Calibration cues (phrasing for calibration meetings, short):

Anjali: ```CALIBRATION NOTES
- Candidate shows consistent delivery and impact beyond scoped work; recommend strong contribution rating.
- Demonstrates solid cross-team influence but still growing in strategic scope.
- High technical ownership; partner-readiness for larger program work next cycle.```

Tessa (People Ops): These are great — can we also add an ultra-short manager question to prompt growth-oriented feedback? Something managers can paste into 1:1 notes.

Priya: ```MANAGER GROWTH PROMPTS
- What would you attempt if you had 20% more time this quarter?
- What technical skill would unlock more impact for you next cycle?
- Which blocker should I own to help you scale your work?```

Miguel: Also adding micro handoff lines for peer feedback when people rotate off projects:

Miguel: ```PEER HANDOFFS
- Took ownership of integration work; left clear runbook and health dashboard.
- Shared knowledge via docs + 30-min walkthrough — ready for handoff.
- Advocated for critical tests that caught three regressions pre-release.```

hr-bot: Reminder: Performance cycle templates + final submission calendar are in Confluence -> People Ops -> Performance Cycle 2026. Due date: 2026-04-14 23:59 UTC. :calendar:

Tessa (People Ops): Perfect, thank you all. I'll collate these into a single microbank doc and post the link here when ready. If anyone else has one-liners, drop them before EOD. :thumbsup:
